title: Run and encode Milestone 0 workflows before schema work
Prove timecoded evidence supports top observed edit intents
Produce operation portability inventory and go/no-go result
Prove one durable turn with existing records before adding abstractions
Add frozen-corpus and creator-outcome gates independent of manifest
Extend admin job-debug with Kria turn and receipt chain
Benchmark frozen workflows against incumbent and AI editors

source_finding: Information architecture and AI-slop audit: bubble/card-per-event rendering destroys hierarchy.

title: Remove brief echo and separate prospective from observed language
source_finding: Current confirmation directly renders thread.state.intent and planning language can be mistaken for completion.

title: Implement receipt, approval, lifecycle, queued-intent, partial, and recovery treatments
source_finding: Interaction-state pass found missing deterministic treatments and controls for the unified runtime.

title: Add live-edge scrolling, New update, announcements, and focus restoration
source_finding: Current unconditional scrollIntoView steals reading position; a11y behavior is unspecified for mutable cards.

title: Persist composer and queued intent across mobile shells and recovery
source_finding: Mobile journey requires continuity across Chat/Editor tabs, project sheet, and offline state.

title: Codify semantic transcript, card, copy, scroll, and focus rules
source_finding: Design-system alignment needs durable guardrails so the chat does not regress to stacked-card event rendering.

title: Add runtime owner, turn, draft, approval, and receipt lifecycle persistence
source_finding: Architecture review requires explicit per-turn leasing, draft CAS, pinned approval, immutable runtime owner, and schema guards.

title: Implement durable v2 turn orchestration on agent-control
source_finding: HTTP-bound model work is not durable and must use leased idempotent tasks with deterministic recovery.

title: Extract editor commit and add portable server draft reducers
source_finding: Approval consumption and exact edit persistence must be one shared transaction without internal HTTP or duplicated browser logic.

title: Reconcile accepted render dispatch and terminal turn continuation
source_finding: Crashes around broker publication and worker terminal writes must converge on one Job/generation.

title: Create direct semantic events, cursor reads, and v1 compatibility
source_finding: Dual event mirroring and repeated full-history polling create split authority, replay, and scaling risks.

title: Add isolated v2 planner/observer contracts and quality evaluations
source_finding: Legacy agent schema cannot be widened safely and observed completion needs receipt/evidence validation plus fallback.

title: Cover state, concurrency, crash, security, format, and user journeys
source_finding: Nineteen new path families need named tests; no silent failure or duplicate side effect may be waived.

title: Extend trace, reconciliation actions, alerts, and runbook
source_finding: Operators must reconstruct turn-to-render outcomes and rescue orphaned durable state.

title: Bound context/drafts and enforce query/queue latency gates
source_finding: Full transcript/editor hydration and shared light-worker contention would degrade long-lived creator threads.

title: Add credential-free whole-turn replay with readable and JSON traces
source_finding: No current runner exercises snapshot through planner, policy, tool, receipt, and semantic observation without live providers or a render.

title: Create one typed Kria tool registry and generated reference
source_finding: Agent registration and capability resolution exist, but neither owns the planned tool schema, risk, retry, executor, manifest, and documentation contract.

title: Standardize KriaProblem and thread-to-generation diagnostics
source_finding: Creator and thread routes mix bare detail strings and code dictionaries, while current admin diagnosis begins from Job rather than thread or turn.

title: Freeze thin route and package ownership boundaries
source_finding: The relevant route and agent files are 3,000 to 8,000 lines; without named packages and transaction ownership the new runtime will become route-owned debt.

title: Derive v2 web types and gate API schema drift
source_finding: Server contracts are hand-mirrored in TypeScript, creating drift risk across cursor, draft, approval, execution, and error states during parallel implementation.

title: Publish one runtime guide and one operator runbook
source_finding: README and CLAUDE present different first-run paths, and the current creator/chat documentation does not give one extension and diagnosis journey.

title: Add verify-kria and safe deterministic local state
source_finding: Engineers need a sub-minute contract gate, seeded lifecycle fixture, and explicit one-thread reset without running the full media pipeline.

title: Measure replay, extension, and diagnosis feedback loops
source_finding: The plan measured creator outcomes and runtime latency but not whether engineers can safely add a tool or diagnose an injected failure.
